cohort: 21 patients who underwent EPH because of intractable PPH and a control group of 89,178 deliveries
finding: Independent risk factors for EPH included DIC, previous cesarean section, placenta previa, PPH, placenta accreta, prenatal use of tocolytic agents, and fetal macrosomia.
mod_finding: This study does not compare outcomes based on mode of delivery, but does find that previous cesarean delivery was an independent risk factor for emergency peripartum hysterectomy.
